nit-faridabad.name: NIT Faridabad
nit-faridabad.about:
NIT, short for New Industrial Township, grew out of the resettlement of families displaced by Partition, and it remains one of the oldest and busiest parts of Faridabad. Homes are mostly independent houses and builder floors on older lanes, spread across numbered areas such as NIT 1, NIT 2, NIT 3 and NIT 5, with long-established local markets and workshops alongside. The township runs along Mathura Road (the old NH-2), with Bata Chowk and Neelam Chowk Ajronda stations on the Violet Line at its edges, and Sectors 15 and 16A close by.

For a tutor, NIT is a doorstep visit: there are no society gates to clear, but lanes are narrow and parking near the markets is tight, so a two-wheeler, or the metro plus an auto for the last leg, works better than a car. Market roads fill up in the evening, so an early after-school slot is easier to keep regular. A home tutor for school subjects can be paired with online classes for specialist boards or exam preparation. Home tutors from nearby sectors and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

old-faridabad.name: Old Faridabad
old-faridabad.about:
Old Faridabad is the historic core of a city founded in 1607, and it is still a dense, lived-in area of independent houses, builder floors and plots, mixed with traditional markets and roadside shops. It sits beside Sectors 16, 17, 18 and 19, with Faridabad railway station in Sector 20A and the Old Faridabad metro station on the Violet Line in Sector 16A, right on Mathura Road. The bypass road and Badkhal Road also pass close by.

Tutors reach most homes directly at the doorstep, since there are few gated complexes, but lanes are narrow and the markets draw crowds in the evening. Coming by metro and walking or taking an auto for the last stretch is usually simpler than driving in. Early after-school sessions and weekend mornings tend to be easier to hold steady than late-evening ones on busy market days. For senior-class subjects that need a specialist, online sessions can sit alongside a local home tutor. Home tutors from nearby sectors and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

jawahar-colony.name: Jawahar Colony
jawahar-colony.about:
Jawahar Colony is an older, closely built residential pocket on the NIT side of Faridabad, made up mainly of independent houses and small flats rather than apartment towers. It lies near Mathura Road (the old NH-2) and the main railway line, with NIT 5 and Sectors 15, 16 and 16A as its neighbours, and the Violet Line stations along Mathura Road are a short auto ride away.

Homes open straight onto the lane, so a tutor walks up to the door without any gate registration, although parking is limited and a two-wheeler is handier than a car. Crossing the railway line and Mathura Road can be slow in the evening rush, so a slot soon after school, or on weekend mornings, is easier to keep regular. Students in higher classes who need a specialist for a particular board or subject can add online classes if a local match is not available straight away. Home tutors from nearby sectors and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

dabua-colony.name: Dabua Colony
dabua-colony.about:
Dabua Colony is an established, affordable residential colony within Sector 50, bounded by Dabua Pali Road, Shahid Bhagat Singh Road and 27 Feet Road. Its neighbours include Old Janta Colony, New Janta Colony, Feroz Gandhi Colony and Nawada Koh, and the local sabzi mandi serves as the everyday market. Air Force Road and the connecting roads lead out towards NIT and Mathura Road.

Most homes are reached directly at the doorstep, so there is no gate registration to arrange, but a tutor should share the block and nearest landmark, as the lanes can be confusing on a first visit. Neelam Chowk Ajronda is among the nearer Violet Line stations, so a tutor coming by metro will usually need an auto for the last leg. Evening traffic builds on the roads towards NIT, so an early after-school slot is easier to keep, and online classes can fill any gap for specialist subjects. Home tutors from nearby sectors and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

sector-7.name: Sector 7
sector-7.about:
Towards the southern end of the central belt, Sector 7 is a mid-range residential sector of builder floors, independent houses and some residential plots. Sectors 3, 4, 6, 8 and 9 and Ballabhgarh lie around it. Sant Surdas (Sihi) and Escorts Mujesar are the nearby Violet Line stations, and Sant Surdas Marg and Mathura Road carry most of the traffic in and out.

Because this is a plotted sector, most homes are visited at the doorstep with no gate formalities, and parking outside a house is usually possible. Tutors living in Sectors 8 and 9 or in Ballabhgarh are close by, while one coming from further up Mathura Road can take the metro and finish by auto. Traffic around the metro stations builds at peak hours, so a slot soon after school is more reliable than a late one. For specialist board subjects or competitive exams, online classes are a practical addition. Home tutors from nearby sectors and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

sector-8.name: Sector 8
sector-8.about:
Sector 8 is one of the older sectors in the southern part of the central belt and has a mainly residential character, with plotted homes, builder floors and independent houses alongside some multi-storey buildings. Its neighbours are Sectors 4, 7, 9 and 10 and the Chawla Colony side of Ballabhgarh, and the Violet Line stations along Mathura Road serve the area.

On these plotted streets a tutor can usually come straight to the door without any gate formalities. Tutors from Sectors 7, 9 and 10 are close neighbours, which keeps travel simple, while someone coming from further north can take the metro and finish the trip by auto. Keep regular sessions clear of the evening rush on Mathura Road, and consider online classes for specialist boards or competitive-exam subjects where a local match is harder to find. Home tutors from nearby sectors and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

sector-9.name: Sector 9
sector-9.about:
A planned HUDA sector in the southern part of the city, Sector 9 is mainly residential, with independent houses, builder floors and low-rise buildings on wide, clean internal roads. It sits beside Sectors 10, 11, 12 and 13, and Escorts Mujesar on the Violet Line is the usual metro stop, with Mathura Road the main route north towards NIT and Delhi.

Because homes are on plotted streets rather than in towers, a tutor simply comes to the door of the house, and parking is usually manageable. Mathura Road is slow at school and office peak hours, so an afternoon or early-evening slot suits tutors coming from further away better than a late one. Tutors from the neighbouring sectors can often walk or ride over. For specialist boards or senior-class subjects, online classes are a practical option alongside a home tutor. Home tutors from nearby sectors and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

sector-10.name: Sector 10
sector-10.about:
Much of Sector 10 is a Housing Board Colony, often written as Sector 10 HBC, laid out in lettered blocks and pockets of independent houses, builder floors and housing board flats, with local parks and markets. Sectors 7, 9, 11, 11C and 12 surround it. Bata Chowk and Neelam Chowk Ajronda on the Violet Line, along with Faridabad New Town railway station, are the usual rail links, and Mathura Road is close at hand.

Tutors should note the block and pocket in the address, because many lanes look alike on a first visit. Homes are reached at the doorstep, so there is no gate registration, and a two-wheeler makes the short hops between sectors easy. Mathura Road is busiest at peak hours, so tutors coming by road from other parts of the city will find an early after-school slot easier to keep. Online classes can cover specialist subjects. Home tutors from nearby sectors and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

sector-11.name: Sector 11
sector-11.about:
With several parks and a quiet residential feel, Sector 11 offers independent floors and apartments across a range of budgets. Sectors 7, 8 and 10 and Sanjay Colony lie around it. Escorts Mujesar is the nearest Violet Line station, with Sant Surdas (Sihi) a little further, and Sant Surdas Marg and Mathura Road are the main roads in and out.

Most homes are on plotted streets, so a tutor comes to the door directly, although apartment buildings may ask for the visitor's name at the entrance. A tutor arriving by metro at Escorts Mujesar needs only a short auto ride for the last leg. Roads near Mathura Road are congested at peak times, so it helps to fix a slot soon after school rather than in the evening rush. For board-specific or exam subjects, online classes can supplement a local tutor. Home tutors from nearby sectors and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

sector-12.name: Sector 12
sector-12.about:
Sector 12 combines homes with some of Faridabad's main public spaces: the Haryana state sports complex and a large town park are here, along with apartments, builder floors and independent houses. Bata Chowk station on the Violet Line stands on Mathura Road in Sector 12, and Sectors 9, 10, 11, 13 and 14 are its neighbours, linked by Sector 15 Road and Maharishi Parashar Marg.

For a tutor, the metro to Bata Chowk and a short auto ride covers most addresses. Apartment residents may need to register the tutor at the gate on the first visit, while house owners can simply share the address and a landmark. Roads around the sports complex, shopping centres and Maharishi Parashar Marg get busy in the evening, so an early after-school slot is easier to keep. Online classes can cover specialist boards. Home tutors from nearby sectors and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

sector-14.name: Sector 14
sector-14.about:
Central and mostly residential, Sector 14 is made up of plotted houses, builder floors and some apartment buildings, with its shopping centred on the HUDA market. It borders Sectors 12, 13 and 15 near Mathura Road. Neelam Chowk Ajronda and Bata Chowk are the nearer Violet Line stations, and Lal Bahadur Shastri Marg and Sector 15 Road connect it to the rest of the city.

Internal roads are wide, so a tutor can usually park near the house and come straight to the door. In the few apartment buildings, share the tutor's name with the gate in advance. The market area and the roads towards Mathura Road are busiest in the evening, so a slot soon after school works well. Tutors from Sectors 12, 15 and 16 are close neighbours, and online classes can be added for specialist subjects. Home tutors from nearby sectors and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

sector-15.name: Sector 15
sector-15.about:
One of the established central sectors, Sector 15 has independent houses, builder floors and residential plots, a family atmosphere and a busy main market. It lies next to Sectors 14 and 16 and close to Ajronda, with Neelam Chowk Ajronda and Bata Chowk as the nearest Violet Line stations, while Sector 15 Road, Lal Bahadur Shastri Marg and Maharishi Parashar Marg link it to Mathura Road.

With plotted homes and wide internal roads, tutors can come straight to the door and usually find parking. The main market and the roads towards Neelam Chowk get crowded in the evening, so an after-school slot before the rush is easier to keep. A tutor coming by metro can take an auto from Neelam Chowk Ajronda for the last leg. For specialist boards or senior-class subjects, online classes can run alongside a home tutor. Home tutors from nearby sectors and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

sector-15a.name: Sector 15A
sector-15a.about:
Sector 15A is a planned residential sector of independent houses and builder floors with broad streets, and it is home to the Neelam Chowk Ajronda metro station on Mathura Road. Sectors 15 and 16A and the NIT area are next door, and Faridabad New Town railway station on the Agra–Delhi line is also nearby.

Having a Violet Line station inside the sector makes 15A easy for tutors from across the city: they can take the metro and walk or take a short auto ride to the house. Homes are visited at the doorstep, so no gate registration is usually needed. Mathura Road around Neelam Chowk is busy at peak hours, so tutors arriving by road should plan around the evening rush, and an early after-school slot is the easiest to keep. Online classes are a good fit for specialist boards. Home tutors from nearby sectors and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

sector-16.name: Sector 16
sector-16.about:
Sector 16 is a centrally placed, established sector of spacious independent houses and builder floors rather than high-rise towers, with its own community centre, parks and the busy Sector 16 market. Sectors 16A, 17, 18 and 19 surround it, Old Faridabad is next door, and the Old Faridabad station on the Violet Line is the metro stop most residents use.

Parking around the Sector 16 market gets tight in the evening, so tutors are better off arriving by two-wheeler, or by metro followed by a short auto ride. Homes are visited at the doorstep, with no gate formalities in most lanes. Because the connecting roads are busy at peak hours, a slot soon after school or on weekend mornings is easier to keep regular. Tutors from Sectors 15, 17 and 18 are close by, and online classes can cover specialist subjects. Home tutors from nearby sectors and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

sector-16a.name: Sector 16A
sector-16a.about:
Home to the Old Faridabad metro station on Mathura Road, Sector 16A is a compact central sector of mainly independent houses. Sectors 15A, 16 and 20A lie around it, with Jawahar Colony and the NIT 5 side of the old township close by, and Faridabad railway station is in the neighbouring Sector 20A.

With both the Violet Line and the railway station nearby, this is one of the easier sectors for a tutor to reach without a car: the metro and a short walk or auto ride cover most addresses. Homes are visited at the doorstep. Mathura Road near the station is busy at peak hours, so an after-school slot before the evening rush is the simplest to keep, and weekend mornings work well for longer sessions. Online classes can be added for specialist boards or exam subjects. Home tutors from nearby sectors and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

sector-17.name: Sector 17
sector-17.about:
Sector 17 is one of the more upmarket HUDA sectors, with independent houses, villas and builder floors on wide, green roads, plus a few gated societies. Sectors 16 and 18 lie alongside, the Old Faridabad station on the Violet Line serves it, and the Faridabad bypass road and Mathura Road (the old NH-2) provide the main road links.

Most homes are independent, so tutors come directly to the door and can usually park outside. In the gated societies, the tutor's name should be registered with security before the first visit. A tutor using the metro will need an auto from Old Faridabad for the last leg. The bypass and Mathura Road are busiest at peak hours, so an after-school slot before the evening rush is the easiest to keep. For specialist boards, online classes work well alongside a home tutor. Home tutors from nearby sectors and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

sector-18.name: Sector 18
sector-18.about:
An established central sector, Sector 18 has mid-income housing made up of independent houses, standalone buildings and rental floors of varying sizes. Sectors 16 and 17 are its neighbours, Old Faridabad and Badkhal Mor are the nearest Violet Line stations, and Ambedkar Marg and Kheri Road carry most local traffic.

Homes are reached at the doorstep, so there is no gate registration to arrange, and tutors from Sectors 16 and 17 are a short ride away. A tutor coming by metro can take an auto from Old Faridabad to finish the trip. Roads towards Mathura Road and Kheri Road are busy in the evening, so a session soon after school or on a weekend morning is easier to keep on schedule. Online classes can cover specialist boards or senior-class subjects where a local match takes longer to find. Home tutors from nearby sectors and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

sector-19.name: Sector 19
sector-19.about:
Sitting right next to Badkhal Mor station on the Violet Line, Sector 19 is an established sector made up mostly of builder floors, with steady rental demand from working families. Old Faridabad, Sector 16 and Rajendra Colony are its neighbours, and the Badkhal flyover connects it to Badkhal Mor and the road towards Surajkund.

The metro station on its doorstep makes Sector 19 easy for tutors from across the city: most can walk from the station or take a very short auto ride. Builder floors mean the tutor comes straight to the door, though it helps to share the floor number in advance. The Badkhal flyover and Mathura Road are busy at peak hours, so tutors arriving by road will find an early after-school slot easier to keep. Online classes can fill in for specialist subjects. Home tutors from nearby sectors and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

sector-21.name: Sector 21A, 21B and 21D
sector-21.about:
The Sector 21 pockets between Old Faridabad and Badkhal, 21A, 21B and 21D, are residential areas of independent houses, builder floors and some multi-storey apartments. 21B is the closest to Old Faridabad railway station and to the Old Faridabad and Badkhal Mor metro stations, while 21A and 21D lie towards Badkhal and the Badkhal flyover, next to Sector 21C.

In the house-and-floor lanes a tutor comes straight to the door, while apartment buildings may ask for the tutor's name at the gate. Tutors using the metro can finish the trip by auto from Old Faridabad or Badkhal Mor; 21D is further from the stations, so a two-wheeler is handier there. The Badkhal flyover and nearby roads are busy at peak hours, so an early after-school slot is easier to hold steady. Online classes can cover specialist boards. Home tutors from nearby sectors and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

sector-21c.name: Sector 21C
sector-21c.about:
Stretching along the Surajkund–Badkhal road, Sector 21C is a HUDA-developed residential sector that mixes builder floors and independent homes with some apartment buildings. It borders Sectors 21A, 26 and 27A and the Rajendra Colony side of Old Faridabad, and Badkhal Mor, Sector 28 and Mewla Maharajpur are the nearest Violet Line stations.

In the plotted parts, a tutor comes straight to the house, while apartment buildings usually want the tutor's name registered at the gate before the first class. A tutor coming by metro will need an auto for the last leg from Badkhal Mor or Sector 28. The Surajkund–Badkhal road is busy at peak hours, so an after-school slot before the evening rush is easier to keep. The sector's residential feel suits regular home classes, and online sessions can cover specialist boards. Home tutors from nearby sectors and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

sector-28.name: Sector 28
sector-28.about:
Sector 28 is an HSVP (formerly HUDA) sector off Mathura Road (the old NH-2), and it has its own station on the Delhi Metro Violet Line, named Sector 28, between Mewla Maharajpur and Badkal Mor. Much of the housing is plotted, and many older houses have been rebuilt as three- and four-bedroom builder floors, with a HUDA market for daily shopping. Sector 29 lies next door, and Sectors 30 and 31 are close by.

For home tuition, plotted streets are easy: a tutor usually reaches the door without gate registration, though builder floors may have a shared entry and an intercom. Tutors coming from Delhi or Ballabhgarh can take the Violet Line to Sector 28 and walk or take an auto for the last leg, which helps avoid peak-hour traffic on Mathura Road. Evening slots after the office rush are often easiest to keep. For specialist subjects such as IB, IGCSE or advanced maths, online sessions widen the choice. Home tutors from nearby sectors and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

sector-29.name: Sector 29
sector-29.about:
Next to Sector 28 and Sector 30, Sector 29 is a settled residential sector with a mix of independent houses, builder floors and some flats in gated societies. Sector 28 station on the Violet Line is the nearest metro stop, Badkal Mor is the next option, and there is a bus stop at the Sector 28/29 chowk. Mawai and the older parts of Faridabad are also close.

Most homes are on plotted streets, so a tutor can usually come straight to the door; flats in gated societies ask for visitor entry at the gate, so it helps to share the tutor's name with security in advance. The metro to Sector 28 plus a short auto ride works well for tutors travelling from other parts of the city, and it avoids the busiest stretch of Mathura Road at peak hours. Families who want a specialist for board-exam science, IB or IGCSE often combine a local home tutor with online classes. Home tutors from nearby sectors and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

sector-30.name: Sector 30
sector-30.about:
Sector 30 is widely known for the Faridabad Police Lines, which includes residential quarters, a parade ground and police offices, so part of the sector is institutional. Around it are residential pockets with flats and builder floors, and nearby colonies include Indraprastha Colony and Dheeraj Nagar. Old Sher Shah Suri Road runs close by, and Sector 28 and Mewla Maharajpur are the nearest Violet Line stations.

For a tutor, the timing matters more than the address: roads towards Mathura Road get busy around office hours, so late-afternoon or evening slots are usually easier to hold each week. Homes in private blocks are reached at the doorstep, so a clear address and landmark are usually all a tutor needs. Metro plus an auto ride suits tutors coming from other sectors, and online classes help for specialist subjects. Home tutors from nearby sectors and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

sector-31.name: Sector 31
sector-31.about:
Mewla Maharajpur station on the Violet Line stands within Sector 31, and Sector 28 station is also close, which makes this one of the easier sectors to reach by metro. The sector mixes homes with shops and offices along Mathura Road and Old Sher Shah Suri Road. Housing is a mix of independent houses, builder floors and some apartments, and neighbouring areas include Sector 32, Chander Nagar, Jal Vayu Vihar and Patel Nagar.

Tutors can take the metro to either station and finish the trip on foot or by auto, which is usually more reliable than driving along Old Sher Shah Suri Road when it is busy in office hours. In plotted streets the tutor comes to the door; in apartment blocks, a gate pass or name at security is common. For senior-school maths, physics or coding, families here often add an online specialist to a home tutor who helps with regular homework. Home tutors from nearby sectors and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

sector-37.name: Sector 37
sector-37.about:
On the Delhi-border edge of Faridabad, Sector 37 is a green, largely residential HSVP sector with independent houses, builder floors and some apartments. Neighbouring areas include Sectors 27D, 34, 35 and 38 and the Sehatpur village area. Sarai is the nearest Violet Line station, with Badarpur Border also close, and Mathura Road gives direct road access to Delhi.

Because it sits close to the border, the sector draws tutors from both south Delhi and central Faridabad; the metro to Sarai and a short auto ride is the usual route, and it avoids queues at the border crossing on Mathura Road during peak hours. Plotted streets mean doorstep visits, while apartment blocks may register visitors at the gate. For niche boards or subjects, an online tutor can fill the gap alongside a home tutor for regular schoolwork. Home tutors from nearby sectors and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

sector-43.name: Sector 43
sector-43.about:
Sector 43 sits along the Surajkund–Badkhal Road at the foot of the Aravalli hills, with a university campus and several large school campuses alongside housing, which gives it a mixed character. Homes range from builder floors to apartments in group-housing societies. Greenfield Colony and Sectors 42, 44, 45 and 46 lie around it, and Surajkund is a short drive along the same road.

Metro users usually get off at NHPC Chowk, Mewla Maharajpur or Sector 28 on the Violet Line and take an auto up towards the hills, so a tutor's arrival depends on the last leg rather than the train. Society flats generally need the tutor to be registered at the gate; builder floors are simpler. Traffic on the Surajkund–Badkhal Road builds up at school and college timings, so a slightly later evening slot often works better. Home tutors from nearby sectors and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

sector-45.name: Sector 45
sector-45.about:
Between Sector 43 and Sector 46, Sector 45 is a mainly residential area with a mix of mid-rise apartment blocks, builder floors and some independent houses. Indraprastha Colony, Greenfields and the Mewla Maharajpur village area are nearby, and both Mathura Road and the Surajkund–Badkhal Road are within easy reach. The nearest Violet Line stations are Sector 28, NHPC Chowk and Mewla Maharajpur.

Tutors coming by metro can reach any of those three stations and take an auto for the last stretch into the sector. In apartment blocks, parents usually need to add the tutor to the visitor list at the gate before the first class; independent houses and floors are simpler. Evening traffic towards Mathura Road can slow arrivals, so agreeing a fixed slot that avoids the office rush helps. For advanced or specialist subjects, online lessons are a practical option. Home tutors from nearby sectors and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

sector-46.name: Sector 46
sector-46.about:
Sector 46 is a quiet, green residential sector near the Aravalli hills, with a mix of apartment complexes, builder floors and plotted houses. It sits beside Sectors 45 and 47, and the Surajkund–Badkhal Road and Mewla Maharajpur Road link it to Mathura Road and to Surajkund. Sector 28 station on the Violet Line is the nearest metro stop, though most residents use an auto to reach it.

For tutors this means the metro alone does not reach the door: an auto or own vehicle is needed for the last part of the trip, and arrivals are steadier outside peak hours. Plotted streets allow doorstep visits, while apartment complexes typically register visitors at the gate. Many families here start with a local home tutor for daily schoolwork and bring in an online specialist for senior-school maths, science or coding. Home tutors from nearby sectors and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

sector-48.name: Sector 48
sector-48.about:
Sector 48 is an older residential area near the Gurugram–Faridabad road, with independent houses and apartments, many of them in long-established blocks. Badkhal Enclave, Nehru Colony, Frontier Colony, Jamai Colony and Sainik Colony in Sector 49 are its neighbours. Old Faridabad and Badkal Mor are the nearest Violet Line stations, and Faridabad railway station is also nearby.

Because the metro stations are not on the doorstep, tutors usually finish the journey by auto or come by their own vehicle, so an evening slot that avoids the office rush is easier to keep. Most homes are independent houses or floors, which means the tutor can come straight to the door without gate registration. For board-exam preparation or specialist subjects, families can pair a nearby home tutor with online classes. Home tutors from nearby sectors and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

sainik-colony.name: Sainik Colony
sainik-colony.about:
Sainik Colony, in Sector 49, was settled largely by ex-servicemen and their families and remains a well-planned, mostly residential colony of independent houses, builder floors and plots, with a few apartment blocks. Aravali Vihar, IP Extension 2 and Nehru Colony also fall within Sector 49, and Sector 48 and Badkhal Enclave are next door. The Gurugram–Faridabad road and Badkhal Pali Road are the main routes out, and Badkhal Lake and the Aravalli hills are nearby.

The nearest Violet Line stations, Badkal Mor and Bata Chowk, are some way off, so tutors usually come by auto or their own vehicle rather than relying on the metro. That makes timing important: afternoons and later evenings avoid the rush on the Gurugram–Faridabad road. Most visits are straight to the door of an independent house or floor. For specialist boards or senior-school subjects, online tutors add choice beyond the local area. Home tutors from nearby sectors and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

charmwood-village.name: Charmwood Village
charmwood-village.about:
Charmwood Village is a large residential township off the Surajkund–Badkhal Road, close to Surajkund and the Delhi border, and the name is widely used for the whole locality. Housing here includes apartment blocks, villas and independent houses. Lakkarpur and Sector 39 lie next to it, and the Mehrauli–Badarpur Road links the area towards Delhi, with the Aravalli hills close by.

The nearest metro stations are on the Violet Line at Badarpur Border and Tughlakabad on the Delhi side, so most tutors arrive by auto, cab or their own vehicle. Apartment blocks and villa enclaves have guarded gates, so it helps to register the tutor with security before the first class. Traffic around Surajkund builds up during events such as the February crafts fair, so parents may want to switch to online lessons on those days. Home tutors from nearby sectors and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

ballabhgarh.name: Ballabhgarh
ballabhgarh.about:
Ballabhgarh is the old market town at the southern end of Faridabad and a tehsil of the district. It grew around the palace built when the town was founded in 1739, still known as Raja Nahar Singh Mahal. Homes here fall into two groups: the older colonies around the main market, with independent houses and small builder floors on narrow plots, and the newer HSVP sectors on the bypass side, with larger plots and wider roads. Mathura Road runs through the town, and the Ballabhgarh railway station sits beside the Raja Nahar Singh metro station, the southern end of the Violet Line.

A tutor can reach most of the town by metro to Raja Nahar Singh and then an auto or e-rickshaw for the last stretch. Lanes in the old colonies are tight, so a tutor on a two-wheeler is often the easiest option, and plotted sectors allow a doorstep visit without gate formalities. Mathura Road and the market area are busiest at school and office hours, so late-afternoon or weekend slots are usually easier to fix, and online classes suit specialist subjects. Home tutors from nearby sectors and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

adarsh-nagar-ballabhgarh.name: Adarsh Nagar, Ballabhgarh
adarsh-nagar-ballabhgarh.about:
Adarsh Nagar is one of the established colonies of old-town Ballabhgarh, grouped with neighbours such as Chawla Colony, Sector 1 and Sector 4. Housing is mostly individual homes and low-rise builder floors on smaller plots, built up over many years rather than planned as a single sector. Everyday shopping is close by in the Ballabhgarh main market, and the Ballabhgarh railway station and the Raja Nahar Singh metro station on the Violet Line are the usual rail links for the area.

A home tutor visiting Adarsh Nagar will normally come by metro or train to Ballabhgarh and finish the trip by auto or e-rickshaw, or ride in on a two-wheeler through the colony lanes. There are no society gates to clear, but parking a car in the inner streets can be awkward, so parents often agree a pickup point. Evenings near the market get crowded, so a fixed weekly slot helps, and online sessions are a good fit for board-exam subjects that need a specialist. Home tutors from nearby sectors and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

NIT & Old Faridabad.fact: Faridabad was founded in 1607 by Sheikh Farid, treasurer to the Mughal emperor Jahangir, to protect the Grand Trunk Road between Delhi and Agra.
After Independence, over 50,000 refugees displaced by Partition were resettled in Faridabad under the leadership of Kamaladevi Chattopadhyay, laying the base of the New Industrial Township (NIT).

In 1949 about 30,000 refugees were lodged in camps near the old Faridabad town; the Indian Co-operative Union, with Kamaladevi Chattopadhyay as its first president, mobilised them to build the township, which grew into a working industrial town within three years.
Old Faridabad metro station on the Violet Line, in Sector 16A on Delhi–Mathura Road, opened on 6 September 2015 and serves Old Faridabad and Sectors 16, 17 and 18.
Bata Chowk metro station stands on Mathura Road in Sector 12, New Industrial Town, and opened on 6 September 2015.
Faridabad railway station (code FDB) is in Sector 20A, Old Faridabad, on the Agra–Delhi chord in the Delhi division of Northern Railway; Faridabad New Town is the next station.

Central Sectors (Mathura Road).fact: The Violet Line section from Badarpur Border to Escorts Mujesar, with nine stations including Old Faridabad, Neelam Chowk Ajronda, Bata Chowk and Badkhal Mor, opened on 6 September 2015.
The Violet Line extension from Escorts Mujesar to Raja Nahar Singh (Ballabhgarh), adding Sant Surdas (Sihi) and Raja Nahar Singh stations, opened on 19 November 2018.
Neelam Chowk Ajronda metro station is on Mathura Road in Sector 15A, between Old Faridabad and Bata Chowk stations.
Badkhal Mor metro station is in Sector 19, between Sector 28 and Old Faridabad stations, and opened on 6 September 2015.
Mathura Road through Faridabad and Palwal is now part of NH-44, which took over the Delhi–Agra section of the former NH-2.
Faridabad expanded along Mathura Road with planned sectors developed by the Haryana Urban Development Authority (HUDA, now HSVP).

Sectors 28–31 & 37.fact: The Violet Line's Faridabad extension, from Badarpur Border to Escorts Mujesar, opened on 6 September 2015, including Sarai, NHPC Chowk, Mewla Maharajpur, Sector 28, Badkhal Mor and Old Faridabad stations.
Sarai metro station is on Mathura Road (NH-19).
NHPC Chowk station is named after NHPC Limited, whose headquarters stands next to it near Mathura Road.
Mewla Maharajpur metro station is in Sector 31, Faridabad; the chhatri and old well at Mewla were notified as state-protected monuments in June 2018.
Sector 28 station is an elevated Violet Line station between Mewla Maharajpur and Badkhal Mor.

Surajkund & Sainik Colony.fact: Surajkund is a 10th-century reservoir in the Aravalli range in Faridabad district; the name means 'Lake of the Sun'.
The Surajkund International Crafts Mela is held every February.
The Gurugram–Faridabad road passes through the Aravalli area around Surajkund.
Anangpur Dam, an 8th-century Tomar-era water-harvesting structure, stands near Anangpur village upstream of Surajkund.
The Surajkund–Badkhal Road links Sector 43 with both Surajkund and Badkhal.

Ballabhgarh & Southern Sectors.fact: The Violet Line extension from Escorts Mujesar to Raja Nahar Singh (Ballabhgarh) was inaugurated on 19 November 2018, adding two elevated stations, Sant Surdas (Sihi) and Raja Nahar Singh.
Raja Nahar Singh station is the southern terminus of the Delhi Metro Violet Line and connects with Ballabhgarh railway station.
Escorts Mujesar station on Mathura Road opened on 6 September 2015 as part of the Violet Line's Faridabad corridor.
Ballabhgarh railway station (code BVH) is on the New Delhi–Mumbai main line and the New Delhi–Agra chord, in Northern Railway's Delhi division, and is served by EMU trains.
Ballabhgarh was founded in 1739 by Raja Balram Singh, who built the Nahar Singh Mahal palace the same year; it is a tehsil of Faridabad district.
Mathura Road, the Delhi–Agra highway through Faridabad and Ballabhgarh, was numbered NH-2 before the 2010 renumbering; the Delhi–Agra route is now NH-44.

Greater Faridabad (Sectors 75–80).fact: The Agra canal is the landmark that separates Greater Faridabad (Neharpar) from the older part of Faridabad.
In Greater Faridabad (Neharpar), Sectors 66 to 74 are industrial sectors and Sectors 75 to 89 are residential sectors.

The Violet Line's Faridabad section (Badarpur to Escorts Mujesar) opened on 6 September 2015 and was extended to Raja Nahar Singh (Ballabhgarh) on 19 November 2018; its Faridabad stations are Sarai, NHPC Chowk, Mewla Maharajpur, Sector 28, Badkhal Mor, Old Faridabad, Neelam Chowk Ajronda, Bata Chowk, Escorts Mujesar, Sant Surdas (Sihi) and Raja Nahar Singh.

The DND–Faridabad–Sohna highway (NH-148NA), which links to the Delhi–Mumbai Expressway, runs on the Faridabad Bypass Road from Sector 37 to Kail Gaon near Ballabhgarh and crosses the Agra canal at Sehatpur bridge; a spur towards Jewar Airport starts at Sector 65 and was reported as under construction.

The Faridabad–Noida–Ghaziabad (FNG) Expressway's Faridabad section starts at the Agra canal overbridge linking Badkhal Road with Mata Amritanandamayi Road; the Haryana section was reported as partly complete in June 2025, with remaining work awaiting revised cost approvals, so it should not be described as open.
Sector 79 hosts a large open-air shopping, office and dining street, described as the biggest shopping complex of the area.

In Greater Faridabad (Neharpar), Sectors 66 to 74 are industrial sectors and Sectors 75 to 89 are residential sectors.

The Violet Line's Faridabad section (Badarpur to Escorts Mujesar) opened on 6 September 2015 and was extended to Raja Nahar Singh (Ballabhgarh) on 19 November 2018; its Faridabad stations are Sarai, NHPC Chowk, Mewla Maharajpur, Sector 28, Badkhal Mor, Old Faridabad, Neelam Chowk Ajronda, Bata Chowk, Escorts Mujesar, Sant Surdas (Sihi) and Raja Nahar Singh.

The DND–Faridabad–Sohna highway (NH-148NA), which links to the Delhi–Mumbai Expressway, runs on the Faridabad Bypass Road from Sector 37 to Kail Gaon near Ballabhgarh and crosses the Agra canal at Sehatpur bridge; a spur towards Jewar Airport starts at Sector 65 and was reported as under construction.

The Faridabad–Noida–Ghaziabad (FNG) Expressway's Faridabad section starts at the Agra canal overbridge linking Badkhal Road with Mata Amritanandamayi Road; the Haryana section was reported as partly complete in June 2025, with remaining work awaiting revised cost approvals, so it should not be described as open.
Amrita Hospital, a multi-speciality hospital on Mata Amritanandamayi Marg in Sector 88, was inaugurated in August 2022.
